summary: 10.0.41.10 3D Tactile Labels, Semantic Amount Coloring, Universal Glassmorphic Detail Drawer, Dynamic Button Role System, Symmetrical Zero-Gap Scrolling Architecture, and 2027 Futuristic Pagination Standard
highlights: 1. 3D Colorful Label Badges & Universal Coverage: Equipped all 464 form and modal labels with tactile 3D icon badges, themed glowing text, and semantic category palettes mirroring IconFactory.java.

2. Semantic Monetary Amount Coloring: Automated real-time column header semantic analysis applying Green (Credit/Paid/Received), Red (Debit/Overdue/Expense), Yellow (Pending/Due/Tax), and Cyan (Total/Taxable/Price) styling across all tables.

3. Universal 3D Glassmorphic Side Detail Drawer: Installed RegisterDetailDrawer.java parity side drawer with dynamic non-blank field extraction, status pills, and context-aware quick actions across all register records.

4. Universal Button Icons & Role Gradients: Centralized button role system (Save, Cancel, Delete, Add, Export, Print, Sync, Filter) with vibrant icons, 7px graphic gap, and desktop UiActionIcons parity across all views and modals.
5. Symmetrical Equal-Height Zero-Gap Layouts: Standardized Archetypes A/B/C/D with flex-stretch containers, eliminating empty right-side/bottom dead zones across all 42 screens and window dialogs.
6. Line-Item Table Real Estate & Anti-Clipping: Maximized table viewports to 75-80%, enabled unclipped 2-line header wrapping, horizontal scroll wrappers, and automated container overflow repair.
7. Purchase Creation Attachment & Table Parity: Repaired vertical layout clipping, restored compact 48px horizontal attachment dropzone, and harmonized responsive table scrolling.
8. Universal 2027 Pagination Strip: Installed modern glassmorphic pagination with neon cyan active pages, record counters, and responsive page switchers across all 34 table views.
